description: Modal dialog for searching, selecting, and importing Jira issues into the current product backlog. Controlled by parent (isOpen/onClose). Fetches issues from the gateway Jira proxy based on user search input.

children.description: Displays a single Jira issue in the search results list with checkbox, issue key, summary, and issue type.

onImport.description: Callback with selected Jira issues mapped to WorkItem format for backlog insertion

projectId.description: Current project ID, passed through to imported WorkItems

jiraProjectKey.description: Optional Jira project key to pre-filter search results

issue.description: The Jira issue mapped to WorkItem format

selected.description: Whether this row is currently selected

onToggle.description: Callback when selection checkbox is toggled

events.onClose: Fired when user clicks Cancel, overlay, close button, or presses Escape
events.onImport: Fired when user clicks Import with selected issues; payload is WorkItem[]
events.onToggle: Fired when user clicks a row checkbox; payload is the issue id

invariants: Import button is disabled when no issues are selected
Import button is disabled while a search is in progress
Selecting a row must not trigger import
Escape closes the modal unless a fetch is in progress
Search input is auto-focused when the modal opens

stateStories.name: Default
stateStories.description: Modal open, empty search field, no results shown yet

stateStories.name: Loading
stateStories.description: Search in progress, spinner visible, results area shows loading state

stateStories.name: WithSelections
stateStories.description: Results visible, some rows checked, Import button enabled

stateStories.name: LongList
stateStories.description: Many results (20+), list scrolls, header/footer remain fixed

layout: Header: title 'Import from Jira' + close button
Search bar: text input with search icon, full width
Results area: scrollable list of JiraIssueRow components
Footer: Cancel button (left-aligned in flex-end group) + Import button
visual.scrolling: Results area scrolls vertically; header and footer are fixed

elements.searchInput: Text input with Search icon (lucide-react) as adornment
elements.issueRow: Checkbox | Issue key (bold, monospace) | Issue type badge | Summary text (truncated)
elements.loadingState: Centered spinner or shimmer in results area
elements.errorState: Red error banner in results area

visual.truncation: Summary text truncated with ellipsis at row boundary

keyboard.Enter: Trigger search when search input is focused
